rationale: The assistant correctly explained F2 as electronics overheat protection, advised cooling and checking ventilation, and in turn two linked the packed drawer to the cause with a sensible retest. It escalated to Bosch service only if F2 recurs with good ventilation, and recommended no parts. Minor issues: some unverified detail (F4 and F5 meanings, 'don't switch off at the wall') and slightly high confidence that the drawer is the cause, though it is well supported by the evidence.
